graphqlPaneOutput.description: GraphQL subscription for pane output events over the /graphql/ws WebSocket endpoint. Yields PaneOutputEvent objects containing content and an RFC 3339 timestamp whenever the pane content changes.
graphqlPaneOutput.title: GraphQL pane output subscription

grpcStreamPaneOutput.description: Server-side stream of pane output events via gRPC. The client sends a StreamPaneOutputRequest and receives a stream of StreamPaneOutputResponse messages, each containing pane content and a Unix timestamp. Only changed content is sent.
grpcStreamPaneOutput.title: gRPC server-streaming pane output

wsPaneOutput.description: Real-time pane content pushed to clients over WebSocket. The server polls tmux at a configurable interval and sends a text frame only when the pane content changes.
wsPaneOutput.title: WebSocket pane streaming

GraphqlPaneOutputEvent.description: GraphQL subscription event with pane content and RFC 3339 timestamp
GraphqlPaneOutputEvent.name: GraphqlPaneOutputEvent
GraphqlPaneOutputEvent.title: GraphQL PaneOutputEvent

GrpcStreamPaneOutputResponse.description: Protobuf-encoded streaming response with pane content and timestamp
GrpcStreamPaneOutputResponse.name: GrpcStreamPaneOutputResponse
GrpcStreamPaneOutputResponse.title: gRPC StreamPaneOutputResponse

WsPaneContent.description: Plain-text WebSocket message containing the full captured pane content
WsPaneContent.name: WsPaneContent
WsPaneContent.title: WebSocket pane content frame

PaneContentText.description: Full captured content of a tmux pane

PaneOutputEvent.description: GraphQL subscription event for pane output

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the content was captured

StreamPaneOutputRequest.description: gRPC request to start streaming pane output

StreamPaneOutputResponse.description: gRPC streaming response with pane content

info.description: Async messaging interfaces for real-time tmux pane streaming
info.title: tmux-gateway

receiveGraphqlPaneOutput.description: Subscribes to the paneOutput field with a target pane and optional interval. Events are delivered over the /graphql/ws WebSocket transport as PaneOutputEvent objects.
receiveGraphqlPaneOutput.summary: Subscribe to pane output via GraphQL subscription

receiveGrpcStreamPaneOutput.description: Initiates a server-streaming RPC. The client sends a StreamPaneOutputRequest with a target pane identifier and polling interval, then receives a stream of StreamPaneOutputResponse messages with content and timestamps.
receiveGrpcStreamPaneOutput.summary: Receive pane output via gRPC server streaming

receiveWsPaneOutput.description: After upgrading the HTTP connection to WebSocket at /ws/pane/{target}, the server polls the target pane at the requested interval and pushes text frames containing the full pane content whenever it changes. The client may close the connection at any time.
receiveWsPaneOutput.summary: Receive real-time pane content via WebSocket
